She looked out at the rolling gray surf, and for the first time in years, she didn’t feel completely alone out on the wind-scoured point.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还沉在浅眠里，街灯把柏油路映成暖橙色的绸带，连白日里聒噪的梧桐都垂着叶尖打盹。早点铺的蒸笼第一次掀开白汽，混着豆浆的甜香飘过半条街，晚归的代驾骑手靠在电动车边揉着发红的眼，环卫工的扫帚划过路面的声响轻得像怕惊醒楼里的梦。远处高架上偶尔驶过一辆夜班公交，车窗里映着空荡的座位，整座城慢得像被按了半速播放键，等着第一缕阳光漫过天际线。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a tiny, simple version of the same problem first, then use that answer to work up to the bigger one, just like opening a set of nested Russian dolls until you reach the tiny solid doll at the center.\n- You always need a clear ‘stop rule’ (called a base case) to avoid looping forever, otherwise you’ll keep opening dolls nonstop until you feel dizzy, much like staring into two mirrors facing each other.\n- Once you get the small core answer, you can stack your steps back up layer by layer, just like climbing back down the ladder you used to reach a high shelf, until you have the full solution to your original question."}
